# Quick Brief: Homework Load Decision

## Key Points

- Short practice sets of ten minutes outperform hour-long homework in every district trial [1]
- Completion rates stayed above ninety percent when tasks kept to ten minutes [2]
- Teachers reported that marking time fell by half under the shorter format [1]
- Families with two working parents rated the ten-minute plan far easier to support [3]
- Maths scores held steady across all six trial schools for two full terms [2]
- Reading logs capped at fifteen minutes showed the strongest home-completion effect [3]

## Bibliography

[1] Woodgate School District (2024). Homework trial term report. https://example.org/woodgate
[2] Northfield Education Trust (2025). Short homework trials, two-year review. https://example.org/northfield
[3] Ashcombe Family Survey (2026). Home support for homework changes. https://example.org/ashcombe
